scientific_interpretation: Weak ARD AICc advantage (~1.9) in all 3 shared-matrix tree inferences is eliminated and reversed if one North American D source is unscored. Directional evolutionary rate asymmetry is NOT supported robustly. Ingroup U ancestral root remains at ~0.5; cannot identify root orientation. Parsimony min 5-6 state changes is a lower bound, not independent U->D gains.
unestimated: actual count and age of U->D evolutionary transitions
Moreyra completed worldwide 294-BioSample and original 350-nuclear-locus species tree
phenotype_ascertainment_design_warning: The five extra Moreyra molecular species added to the Japan38 nuclear tree were explicitly chosen partly to cover U/D contrasts across North America and West Palearctic. An Mk model fitted to this selected 45-tip phylogram cannot be interpreted as an unbiased worldwide character transition-rate estimate or population frequency estimate. The subsequent nine source specimens were selected by geography without inspecting head/colour traits, specifically to reduce this selection bias.
